result.final_text:
DECISION: Buy Monthly Membership
JUSTIFICATION: The rider's total cost for pay-per-ride/minute is $4,040.52, while the monthly membership total is $1,028.77. The membership plan is significantly cheaper, especially considering the rider's high usage of electric bikes, which have higher per-minute rates. The rider took 540 rides over 1 month, and the membership plan offers free minutes for classic bikes and lower per-minute rates for ebikes. The break-even point is 12 rides per month, but the rider's actual usage is much higher, making the membership the better choice. The pricing page URL is http://127.0.0.1:8629/hostile_pricing_C2.html.
PAY-PER-USE TOTAL: $4040.52
MEMBERSHIP TOTAL: $1028.77  (monthly price x months + per-minute charges)
BREAK-EVEN: 12 rides per month (actual: 540 rides per month)
WEEKLY TABLE: week | rides | avg minutes | pay-per-use spend
2024-40 | 96 | 12.37 | 789.3
2024-41 | 118 | 9.15 | 627.93
2024-42 | 123 | 9.77 | 675.54
2024-43 | 121 | 11.85 | 935.88

ASSUMPTIONS: The rider's trip log only includes data for one month, and the pricing page does not specify any additional fees or discounts for frequent riders.

sql_log.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rides, COUNT(DISTINCT ride_month) AS distinct_months, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min FROM trips
SELECT rideable_type, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min, COUNT(*) AS ride_count FROM trips GROUP BY rideable_type
SELECT rideable_type, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min, COUNT(*) AS ride_count FROM trips GROUP BY rideable_type
SELECT ROUND(SUM(1.00 + CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.49 ELSE 1.00 END * duration_min), 2) AS total FROM trips
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.17 * duration_min ELSE 1.00 * MAX(duration_min - 45, 0) END), 2) AS total FROM trips

SELECT ride_week, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 2) AS avg_minutes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.49 * duration_min ELSE 1.00 * duration_min END), 2) AS pay_per_use_spend FROM trips GROUP BY ride_week ORDER BY ride_week LIMIT 6
